lines.en: label day16:
scene black
"Time: 11:30 AM \n
lines.zh: 时间：上午 11:30

lines.en: Location: Soccer Field \n
lines.zh: 地点：足球场

lines.en: Mission: Operation Fallen Angel"
lines.zh: 任务：行动代号 堕天使

lines.en: scene newfallen1
: Okay, Sana! Just like we practiced! Are you ready to do this?
lines.zh: : 好了，Sana！就照我们练的那样来！你准备好了吗？

lines.en: : Umm...not really...
lines.zh: : 呃……其实没有……

lines.en: : Well, too bad! Because everything you have done in life so far has led up to this very moment!
lines.zh: : 那太遗憾了！因为你迄今为止所做的一切，都是为了这一刻！

lines.en: : This might be the only chance you ever get to show everyone that you have the potential to be an Oscar winning actress!
lines.zh: : 这可能是你唯一一次机会，让大家看到你有成为奥斯卡影后的潜质！

lines.en: scene newfallen2
: But...I don't even want to be an actress...
lines.zh: : 可是……我根本不想当演员啊……

lines.en: : What? But I think you'd be so great at it. All of our practices so far have gone really well.
lines.zh: : 什么？可我觉得你超适合的。我们到目前为止的排练都很顺利啊。

lines.en: : Ayane...I don’t really know if this is a good idea...
lines.zh: : Ayane……我真不知道这到底是不是个好主意……

lines.en: : Sensei is smart, so...he'll probably see right through this...
lines.zh: : Sensei 很聪明，所以……他大概一眼就能看穿吧……

lines.en: scene newfallen3
: That's exactly why we've gotta sell it. But with how flawlessly our three practices have been, I doubt that will be an issue.
lines.zh: : 所以我们才要演得逼真啊。不过我们三次排练都完美无缺，我倒觉得这不成问题。

lines.en: : Is three...really enough? Maybe we should...practice a little more before...actually trying this...
lines.zh: : 三次……真的够吗？我们要不要……再多练练，再……真的试一次……

lines.en: : Sana, I need you to understand something for me.
lines.zh: : Sana，我需要你明白一件事。

lines.en: : If I have to wait even one more day to get closer to Sensei, I am going to literally blow myself up and take the entire school with me.
lines.zh: : 要是再让我多等一天才能跟 Sensei 更进一步，我真的会把自己炸了，顺便把整所学校一起带走。

lines.en: : Please don't...my Switch is in there...
lines.zh: : 别这样……我的 Switch 还在里面呢……

lines.en: : Sana, we can do this. Just act natural.
lines.zh: : Sana，我们做得到的。表现得自然点就行。

lines.en: scene newfallen4
: That's a lot easier said than done...
lines.zh: : 这话说起来容易做起来难啊……

lines.en: : It’ll be fine! Don’t worry about it.
lines.zh: : 没问题的！别担心。

lines.en: scene newfallen5
: Okay...I blew the whistle, so...I don't know. Go play sports or something.
lines.zh: : 好了……哨子我吹过了，所以……我不知道。去做点运动什么的吧。

lines.en: : Oh God. This is it. This is it. How do I look?
lines.zh: : 哦天哪。来了。来了。我看起来怎么样？

lines.en: : Um...normal?...
lines.zh: : 呃……很正常？……

lines.en: : But I'm normally pretty, right? Sana, answer me. We're running out of-
lines.zh: : 可我平时都挺漂亮的吧？Sana，快回答我。我们快没时——

lines.en: scene newfallen6
: AYANE HAS FALLEN! THIS IS A TRULY TRAGIC EVENT!
lines.zh: : AYANE 摔倒了！这真是场惨剧！

lines.en: : What?! Oh God! I wasn't ready!
lines.zh: : 什么？！哦天哪！我还没准备好啊！

lines.en: : IS ANYONE HERE STRONG ENOUGH TO CARRY A YOUNG GIRL TO THE NURSE'S OFFICE?!
lines.zh: : 这里有谁力气够大，能把一位年轻女孩送去保健室吗？！

lines.en: : I think I can probably-
lines.zh: : 我应该可以——

lines.en: : IS ANYONE {i}ELSE{/i} HERE STRONG ENOUGH TO CARRY A YOUNG GIRL TO THE NURSE'S OFFICE?!
lines.zh: : 这里还有{i}别的{/i}力气够大的人，能把一位年轻女孩送去保健室吗？！

lines.en: scene newfallen7
: I am dying! Could this be the end for me?! But I am still so young!
lines.zh: : 我要死了！难道我就要走到尽头了吗？！可我还这么年轻啊！

lines.en: : I MAY NEVER WALK AGAIN!
lines.zh: : 我可能再也没法走路了！

lines.en: scene newfallen8
: Sana, no! That one was my line!
lines.zh: : Sana，别！那句是我的台词！

lines.en: : AYANE MAY NEVER WALK AGAIN!
lines.zh: : AYANE 可能再也没法走路了！

lines.en: scene newfallen7
: I may never walk again!
lines.zh: : 我可能再也没法走路了！

lines.en: : What’s going on? What happened?
lines.zh: : 怎么回事？发生什么了？

lines.en: scene newfallen9
: Sensei?...Is that you?...
lines.zh: : Sensei？……是你吗？……

lines.en: : Your voice sounds so...distant...
lines.zh: : 你的声音听起来好……遥远……

lines.en: scene newfallen6
: THE LIGHT IS FADING FROM HER EYES!
lines.zh: : 她眼里的光正在消失！

lines.en: : Okay Sana, I’m going to need you to step aside for a moment.
lines.zh: : 好了 Sana，我需要你先让开一下。

lines.en: scene newfallen9
: What happened? I feel like I looked away from you for one second.
lines.zh: : 出什么事了？我感觉自己才刚把视线从你身上移开一秒钟。

lines.en: : As flattered as I am to know that you are always watching me, I really don't know...
lines.zh: : 知道你一直都在看着我，我当然很受宠若惊，不过我真的不知道……

lines.en: : It is as if one moment I was talking about the decline of our current economy with Sana...and the next...
lines.zh: : 就好像上一秒我还在跟 Sana 聊当前经济的衰退……然后下一秒……

lines.en: : The next thing I know...I can’t feel my legs...
lines.zh: : 等我回过神来……我的腿已经没有知觉了……

lines.en: : Sensei...am I going to die?
lines.zh: : Sensei……我会死吗？

lines.en: : Maybe? I have no idea.
lines.zh: : 也许吧？我也不知道。

lines.en: : Can you...prevent me from dying?
lines.zh: : 你能……不让我死吗？

lines.en: : I can carry you to the nurse’s office. That {i}is{/i} what you two were yelling about, isn't it?
lines.zh: : 我可以抱你去保健室。你们俩刚刚喊的不就是{i}这个{/i}吗？

lines.en: : And you're always listening as well...
lines.zh: : 而且你也一直在听啊……

lines.en: : I knew I could count on you, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 我就知道可以指望你，Sensei……

lines.en: scene black
Knowing full well that something suspicious is going on, I lift Ayane off of the ground and bring her body close to my chest in a princess carry.
lines.zh: 我明知其中有诈，还是把 Ayane 从地上抱了起来，以公主抱的姿势将她的身体贴在自己胸前。

lines.en: That does not stop a certain someone from carrying on the performance, however.
lines.zh: 不过这并没有阻止某个人继续她的表演。

lines.en: scene newfallen10
: AYANE! WHY?! YOU WERE SO YOUNG AND HAD SO MUCH LEFT TO DO!
lines.zh: : AYANE！为什么？！你还这么年轻，还有那么多事没做！

lines.en: : I CAN ONLY HOPE THERE IS ENOUGH ROOM IN HEAVEN FOR ONE MORE ANGEL!
lines.zh: : 我只希望天堂里还挤得下多一位天使！

lines.en: : Sana is-
lines.zh: : Sana 她——

lines.en: : Don't pay any attention to Sana. I am the one in need of medical assistance.
lines.zh: : 别管 Sana。需要救治的人是我。

lines.en: : Right...
lines.zh: : 好吧……

lines.en: : I'm sorry for being so heavy, Sensei...making you work this hard during gym class is something I will never be able to live down.
lines.zh: : 对不起我这么重，Sensei……让你在体育课上这么辛苦，我这辈子都没法赎罪了。

lines.en: : You’re like 80 pounds.
lines.zh: : 你才八十磅吧。

lines.en: scene newfallen11
: Then that's 80 whole pounds worth of inconvenience for you...
lines.zh: : 那也是整整八十磅的麻烦要你扛啊……

lines.en: : Sensei...what will I do if I can never walk again?
lines.zh: : Sensei……要是我永远都不能走路了，我该怎么办？

lines.en: : Will you carry me everywhere for the rest of your life?
lines.zh: : 你会一辈子都这样抱着我到处走吗？

lines.en: : Absolutely not.
lines.zh: : 绝对不会。

lines.en: : I could push you around in a wheelchair from time to time, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我可以偶尔推着轮椅带你转转。

lines.en: : I will take what I can get...
lines.zh: : 能给多少我都收下……

lines.en: scene black
I carry Ayane into the nurse’s office, expecting to find...you know, a {i}nurse...{/i}but no one is there at all.
lines.zh: 我把 Ayane 抱进保健室，本以为会看到……你知道的，一位{i}护士{/i}……可里面一个人都没有。

lines.en: Which quickly makes it even more apparent that this was all some coordinated effort to get the two of us alone in here.
lines.zh: 这很快就让一切更加明显：这一切都是精心安排，就为了让我俩单独待在这儿。

lines.en: And while having Ayane pull a stunt like that doesn’t surprise me, the cooperation of Sana does.
lines.zh: Ayane 耍这种花招我并不意外，但 Sana 会配合倒让我吃惊。

lines.en: Granted, calling Sana’s overacting “cooperation” might be a little generous, but it’s strange considering that she’d comply with a demand that very clearly...looks wrong.
lines.zh: 当然，把 Sana 那夸张的演技称作「配合」可能有点抬举她了，可她居然会答应一个明摆着……不太对劲的要求，这本身就挺奇怪的。

lines.en: I’m sure some of the other girls are thinking the same thing right about now. And I’m sure that’s something I should be worrying about.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，这会儿其他一些女生也在想同样的事。而我也清楚，这才是该让我担心的地方。

lines.en: But I have a hard time worrying about anything at all while I’m so distracted by the intense gaze coming from the girl I’m carrying and her soft skin, still warm from soaking up the sun.
lines.zh: 可当我被怀里这个女孩炽热的目光、还有她那被太阳晒得温热的柔软皮肤搅得分神时，我实在很难去担心任何事。

lines.en: When I bring her to the back of the nurse’s office and close the curtain around us, the facade fades and she returns to her normal self.
lines.zh: 当我把她抱到保健室最里面、拉上帘子把我们围起来时，那层伪装褪去，她又变回了平常的自己。

lines.en: scene newfallen12
Or perhaps her normal self never went into hiding at all.
lines.zh: 又或许，她那平常的自己根本从未藏起来过。

lines.en: Perhaps Ayane’s normal self {i}is{/i} pulling theatrical stunts to create small windows of opportunity for the two of us to climb through.
lines.zh: 也许 Ayane 的本来面目，{i}就是{/i}在用这种戏剧化的花招，为我们俩撬开一扇扇小小的机会之窗。

lines.en: Perhaps she likes me so much that she’s willing to risk the way she appears to her classmates just so that I can whisk her away and lay her down on some presumably unfamiliar bed.
lines.zh: 也许她太喜欢我了，宁愿冒着在同班同学面前形象尽毁的风险，也只为让我把她带走、放在这张大概并不熟悉的床上。

lines.en: Perhaps that’s exactly what I like about her.
lines.zh: 也许，这正是我喜欢她的地方。

lines.en: It’s hard to tell.
lines.zh: 很难说。

lines.en: Because even if I can make lofty assumptions about the type of person she truly is and how every aspect of her somehow revolves around me-
lines.zh: 因为即便我可以高谈阔论地猜测她究竟是怎样的人、她身上每一点又如何绕着我转——

lines.en: I know that the true center of gravity that she and all of the others are revolving around is somewhere far away from here.
lines.zh: 我也清楚，她和所有其他人真正围绕旋转的那个重心，在离这里很远很远的地方。

lines.en: And that they’re all just aimlessly drifting around at this point.
lines.zh: 而她们此刻都只是在漫无目的地飘着。

lines.en: But that will not stop me from attempting to lasso her into my gravitational pull.
lines.zh: 但这不会阻止我试着用套索把她拽进我的引力之中。

lines.en: And that will not stop me from imagining the horrible things I’m imagining right now.
lines.zh: 也不会阻止我去想象此刻脑子里那些可怕的事。

lines.en: : You didn’t buy that at all, did you?
lines.zh: : 你一点都没上当，对吧？

lines.en: : I knew what was going on from the start.
lines.zh: : 我从一开始就知道是怎么回事了。

lines.en: : Guess Sana’s Oscar is out of the question after all.
lines.zh: : 看来 Sana 的奥斯卡是彻底没戏了。

lines.en: : What else did you expect when you cast the silent recluse in such a dramatic role?
lines.zh: : 你让那个沉默寡言的家里蹲来演这么戏剧化的角色，还能指望什么？

lines.en: : I couldn’t think of anyone else who would have helped me do what I was trying to do. It had to be Sana.
lines.zh: : 我想不出还有谁会帮我做我想做的事。只能是 Sana。

lines.en: : Because she’s...okay with your incessant pursuit of me?
lines.zh: : 因为她……对你没完没了地追我无所谓？

lines.en: : I think it’s closer to that she doesn’t really understand right now.
lines.zh: : 我觉得更接近于，她现在其实还没真正搞明白。

lines.en: : She obviously knows I like you. {i}Everybody{/i} knows that much. But I don’t think Sana’s ready to acknowledge how {i}you{/i} feel just yet.
lines.zh: : 她当然知道我喜欢你。这点{i}所有人都{/i}知道。但我觉得 Sana 还没准备好去承认{i}你{/i}的感受。

lines.en: : Are you saying {i}you{/i} know how I feel?
lines.zh: : 你是说，{i}你{/i}知道我的感受？

lines.en: scene newfallen13
: I’m saying that you walked right past a bed that {i}wasn’t{/i} curtained off so you could bring me in here.
lines.zh: : 我是说，你特意走过一张{i}没有{/i}帘子遮挡的床，就为了把我抱到这里面来。

lines.en: : I just figured you’d want {i}medical assistance{/i} in private.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，你会想在私密的地方接受{i}救治{/i}。

lines.en: : Sensei...can I ask you something?
lines.zh: : Sensei……我能问你一件事吗？

lines.en: : Sure. Just ask quietly since we don’t know if anyone is listening in right now.
lines.zh: : 当然。小声点问就好，毕竟我们不知道这会儿有没有人在偷听。

lines.en: : It’s only a matter of time until they start asking similar questions, but sure. I’ll stay quiet.
lines.zh: : 她们迟早也会开始问类似的问题啦，不过好，我会小声的。

lines.en: : What do you want to know, Ayane? It’s not often you let down the bubbly, eccentric persona to act all...serious like this.
lines.zh: : 你想知道什么，Ayane？你可不常卸下那副活泼古怪的样子，露出这么……认真的一面。

lines.en: scene newfallen14
: I know. Having you hold me for so long made me want to start saying things that will get you to hold me again. So I’m sorry for just forcing this on you out of the blue.
lines.zh: : 我知道。被你抱了这么久，我就开始想说些能让你再抱我一次的话。所以很抱歉，我突然就这么把事情强加给你了。

lines.en: : The initial intention and the whole point of this stunt was to create an opportunity where I could kiss you.
lines.zh: : 这次闹剧最初的目的、也是全部的意义，就是制造一个我能吻你的机会。

lines.en: : And I’m still probably going to do that.
lines.zh: : 而且我大概还是会吻的。

lines.en: : Oh?
scene newfallen15
: But what I want to ask {i}before{/i} I do that is...
lines.zh: : 不过在吻{i}之前{/i}，我想先问的是……

lines.en: : When did you start seeing me as a {i}girl{/i} and not just a “girl?”
lines.zh: : 你是什么时候开始把我当成一个{i}女人{/i}，而不只是一个「女孩」的？

lines.en: : I’m sorry, what?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你说什么？

lines.en: : I know you don’t need that explained to you. The Sensei I love is smarter than that.
lines.zh: : 我知道你不需要我解释。我爱的那个 Sensei 可比这聪明多了。

lines.en: : You should probably clarify anyway as this could spiral out of control if I somehow misinterpret the situation and say the {i}wrong{/i} thing.
lines.zh: : 你最好还是说明白点，万一我理解错了、说了{i}不该说的{/i}话，局面可就失控了。

lines.en: scene newfallen16
: Fine...Fine. Okay.
lines.zh: : 好吧……好吧。行。

lines.en: : What I’m asking is...
lines.zh: : 我想问的是……

lines.en: scene newfallen17
: Wait, do you want me to word it in just the...super blunt way? Or the way where I kind of tiptoe around what I’m trying to say, but still heavily imply it?
lines.zh: : 等等，你是想让我用那种……超级直白的说法？还是那种绕来绕去、但暗示得极其明显的说法？

lines.en: : Just be blunt. It’ll save both of us some time.
lines.zh: : 直说吧。省得浪费我俩的时间。

lines.en: : Okay.
: Then, when did you start thinking about me, like...sexually? Not just as Ami’s friend who hangs out at your house all the time.
lines.zh: : 那么，你是什么时候开始……对我有那种想法的？不再只是把我当成那个老赖在你家里的 Ami 的朋友。

lines.en: : Was it after the bathroom incident? Before that? I just want to know when.
lines.zh: : 是在洗手间那件事之后？还是在那之前？我只想知道是什么时候。

lines.en: : Because I have been watching the way you look at me closely for years...and it wasn’t until recently that those looks started...you know, looking like they...look now.
lines.zh: : 因为你看着我的眼神，我已经盯了好几年了……而直到最近，那些眼神才开始……你知道的，变成现在这样。

lines.en: : Am I allowed to counter that question with another question?
lines.zh: : 我可以用另一个问题来回应这个问题吗？

lines.en: : Is it the same question as mine?
lines.zh: : 是跟我同一个问题吗？

lines.en: scene newfallen18
: Heheh...of course it is.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……当然是啦。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, I don’t really know when that started happening on my end. It was probably just a...natural development since I didn’t know where else to aim my hormones.
lines.zh: : 可惜，我也不知道自己是从什么时候开始的。大概只是……自然发展吧，毕竟我当时也不知道还能把荷尔蒙往哪儿使。

lines.en: scene newfallen17
: The bathroom incident definitely made it worse, though. I didn’t even sleep that night, did you know that?
lines.zh: : 不过洗手间那件事确实让情况更糟了。那晚我连觉都没睡，你知道吗？

lines.en: : I didn’t. Nor would I have expected it after you literally ran away.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。而且你当时可是直接跑掉了，我也想不到会那样。

lines.en: scene newfallen19
: Can you blame me?! Not only was that thing the size of my torso, but I told everybody I’d be back in a couple minutes!
lines.zh: : 你能怪我吗？！那东西光是尺寸就快赶上我的躯干了好吗，而且我还跟大家说了几分钟就回来！

lines.en: scene newfallen20
: There’s also a huge difference between fantasizing about things and actually {i}doing{/i} them.
lines.zh: : 而且，幻想一件事和真的去{i}做{/i}一件事之间，差别可大了。

lines.en: : And I think if I’m acting weird and not like normal Ayane right now, it’s because that is finally starting to set in.
lines.zh: : 我想，如果我现在表现得很奇怪、不像平常的 Ayane，那是因为这件事终于开始在我心里落地了。

lines.en: : Seeing the way you look at me change as I grow up is, like...tricking my brain into thinking that a relationship like that is actually possible.
lines.zh: : 看着你看我的眼神随着我长大而改变，就像……在骗我的大脑，让它以为那样的关系其实是可能的。

lines.en: : All this time, I’ve been saying all of that stuff about being in love with you in a joking manner because, frankly, the thought of anything ever coming from it {i}was{/i} just a joke to me.
lines.zh: : 一直以来，我都是以开玩笑的口吻说那些「我爱上你了」之类的话，因为老实说，要真能有什么结果，这念头本身对我而言{i}就是{/i}个笑话。

lines.en: : Not in the sense that I didn’t want it, but in the sense that it just seemed impossible.
lines.zh: : 不是不想要，而是它看起来根本不可能。

lines.en: scene newfallen21
: But now?
lines.zh: : 但现在呢？

lines.en: : Now, any time I say any of that stuff, it’s not really a joke at all. It’s a wish. And it’s a wish that seems more and more possible every time we’re alone together like this.
lines.zh: : 现在，我再说那些话的时候，就一点都不好笑了。那是一个愿望。而每当我们像这样单独相处，这个愿望就显得越来越可能成真。

lines.en: : Now, at the risk of me saying anything else embarrassing, can you please tell me when your...thoughts on me started changing?
lines.zh: : 现在，冒着再说些丢人话的风险，你能告诉我，你……对我的看法是从什么时候开始变的吗？

lines.en: : And if they haven’t and I’m just an idiot, can you rip the bandage off while we’re in here?
lines.zh: : 要是根本没变、只是我自己在犯蠢，你能趁我们在这儿的时候，干脆把创可贴一把撕掉吗？

lines.en: : Because at least there’s disinfectant everywhere and I can...prevent this wound from getting infected or something.
lines.zh: : 因为至少这里到处都是消毒水，我还能……防止这道伤口感染什么的。

lines.en: Sure, let me just respond to a question I don’t have an answer for.
lines.zh: 好啊，那我就来回答一个我自己都没有答案的问题吧。

lines.en: There {i}is{/i} no {i}one{/i} moment where the way I look at Ayane has changed from my perspective.
lines.zh: 在我看来，并不存在{i}某一个{/i}我看着 Ayane 的目光突然改变的瞬间。

lines.en: I have always viewed her in the light she assumes I’m viewing her in. And it’s not at all dissimilar from the one that lights up everyone else as well.
lines.zh: 我一直都是用她以为我在用的那种目光看她的。而那道光照亮她的方式，跟照亮其他所有人的方式并无二致。

lines.en: I have no reason to view her as “Ami’s friend” because, to me, she has always been the beautiful girl I see before me.
lines.zh: 我没有理由把她看作「Ami 的朋友」，因为对我来说，她一直都是眼前这个美丽的女孩。

lines.en: Of course, I can’t tell her that either. Because not only would it dispel my illusion as a vulture gorging himself on the scraps of relationships left behind by another animal-
lines.zh: 当然，这话我也不能对她说。因为那不仅会戳破我作为一只秃鹫、大快朵颐另一只动物留下的感情残骸的幻象——

lines.en: But it would damage her.
lines.zh: 更会伤害到她。

lines.en: And I don’t want to risk this beauty being damaged in any form.
lines.zh: 而我不想让这份美以任何形式受到损伤。

lines.en: So, much like escorting her into a private section of the nurse’s office instead of keeping her out in the open-
lines.zh: 所以，就像我把她带进保健室里那个私密的位置、而不是让她留在外面一样——

lines.en: I will take the safe route.
lines.zh: 我会选择安全的那条路。

lines.en: And any bandages we have on ourselves will stay right where they are.
lines.zh: 而我们身上贴着的那些创可贴，就继续待在原处吧。

lines.en: : I don’t really know either, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我其实也不知道，Ayane。

lines.en: : It just...kind of happened...
lines.zh: : 只是……不知不觉就这样了……

lines.en: scene newfallen22
: I see...
lines.zh: : 这样啊……

lines.en: : I guess we’re not all that different then.
lines.zh: : 看来我们也没那么不一样嘛。

lines.en: : Welp, I guess that means there’s only one thing left to do.
lines.zh: : 好吧，看来接下来只剩一件事可做了。

lines.en: scene newfallen23
Ayane brings herself closer  and I can feel the weight of years worth of unrequited feelings slipping into my nostrils and suffocating me with the invisible mass of a love I don’t deserve.
lines.zh: Ayane 凑了过来，我能感觉到多年单恋的重量正钻进我的鼻腔，用那份我不配拥有的爱的无形质量将我窒息。

lines.en: Of a love I wouldn’t call {i}love{/i} in the first place.
lines.zh: 一份我根本就不会称之为{i}爱{/i}的爱。

lines.en: This is nothing more than hormonal lust consuming her like it’s the physical manifestation of a parasitic fungus trying to take control of her entirely.
lines.zh: 这不过是荷尔蒙驱动的欲望在吞噬她，就像某种寄生真菌的实体化，试图彻底控制她。

lines.en: Is she strong enough to fight it off?
lines.zh: 她有足够的力量抵抗它吗？

lines.en: : You have no idea how long I’ve wanted to do this.
lines.zh: : 你根本不知道我想做这件事想了多久。

lines.en: Or has life simply become so worthless to her that she’d rather surrender herself entirely to the promise of someone or something acting out in her stead?
lines.zh: 又或者，生活对她而言已经廉价到，她宁愿把自己彻底交给某个承诺代替她行动的人或东西？

lines.en: : You’re right.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。

lines.en: : I really don’t.
lines.zh: : 我真的不知道。

lines.en: scene newfallen24
Our lips meet and spores spread throughout her trembling body.
lines.zh: 我们的唇相贴，孢子在她颤抖的身体里扩散开来。

lines.en: We remain stuck like that for somewhere between thirty seconds and two minutes.
lines.zh: 我们就那样黏在一起，时间大概在三十秒到两分钟之间。

lines.en: I lose track of time as I must focus everything I have on not killing the host body before the fungus does.
lines.zh: 我彻底失去了时间感，因为我必须集中全部精力，以免自己比真菌更先一步杀死这具宿主的身体。

lines.en: If she does this to herself, it won’t be my fault.
lines.zh: 如果这是她自己对自己做的，那就不是我的错。

lines.en: scene newfallen25
Which is why I do not run once her lips part.
lines.zh: 所以当她唇瓣分开时，我没有逃走。

lines.en: Which is why my hands travel without obstacle to the mounds on the front and the back of her growing body.
lines.zh: 所以当我的手毫无阻碍地滑向她正在发育的身体前方与后方的隆起时，也是如此。

lines.en: : Hello? Is anyone in here?
lines.zh: : 喂？有人在吗？

lines.en: Which is why I do not stop even when our existence is threatened.
lines.zh: 所以即便我们的存在受到了威胁，我也没有停下。

lines.en: The worst that can happen is that we’re crushed underfoot. And if that {i}were{/i} to occur, we’d simply wind up as something else after an indeterminate amount of time.
lines.zh: 最坏的结果，也不过是我们被踩碎。而即便{i}真的{/i}如此，经过一段无法确定的时间后，我们也会变成别的什么东西。

lines.en: I can tell she’s still growing.
lines.zh: 我看得出她还在长大。

lines.en: I can tell there are still more spores to spread.
lines.zh: 我看得出还有更多孢子要散播。

lines.en: : Sensei?...
lines.zh: : Sensei？……

lines.en: : Ayane?...
lines.zh: : Ayane？……

lines.en: : Anybody?...
lines.zh: : 有人吗？……

lines.en: scene black
We remain behind the curtain with our tongues entangled until a girl who would break if she caught us disappears.
lines.zh: 我们在帘子后舌齿交缠，直到那个要是撞见我们就会崩溃的女孩离开。

lines.en: The thing is, Ami could have opened up that curtain at any moment.
lines.zh: 问题是，Ami 随时都可以拉开那道帘子。

lines.en: But she didn’t.
lines.zh: 但她没有。

lines.en: I don’t know if she’s just {i}that{/i} absentminded...or if she was afraid of what she would find.
lines.zh: 我不知道她只是{i}那么{/i}心不在焉……还是说，她害怕自己会看见什么。

lines.en: But we live to see another day.
lines.zh: 不过我们活下来，又能见到明天的太阳了。

lines.en: I can’t guarantee it will be a brighter one-
lines.zh: 我不能保证那会是更明亮的一天——

lines.en: But we will see it nonetheless.
lines.zh: 但我们终究还是会看到它。
